text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer multi-paragraph development with repeated reasons","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into an introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion with repeated support for its main idea."},{"evidence":"“First,” “Second,” “Additionally,” “My first reason,” “My second reason,” “My last reason”","quality":"transitional control","description":"The essay uses sequencing and connective phrases more consistently to guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"“what happens when a animals get sick,” “what kind of medicine they give the animals”","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay develops its reasons with more specific supporting details rather than staying at a brief anecdotal level."},{"evidence":"“when I grow up,” “learning new things is much better for you”","quality":"purposeful development","description":"The essay more often explains why the writer cares about the topic and how the experience connects to future goals."},{"evidence":"“how you treat the animals,” “what they do”","quality":"topic focus","description":"The essay stays more consistently centered on the chosen subject and repeats its central ideas in a controlled way."}]}
